multiplicity: Holm within each modality's frozen deployable family
simultaneous_intervals: Bonferroni familywise subject-clustered bootstrap within modality
candidate_oracle: descriptive and outside the deployable family
selected_best_caller: descriptive post-selection summary; all frozen callers remain in inference
external_strata_rule: new-library overlapping-donor cohorts are reported separately and never pooled into the primary donor-independent estimate
family_policy: Holm correction runs within each modality's frozen deployable always-call comparator family. Abstaining rules such as SimpleTwoThirdsConsensus are excluded from that family and reported separately with callability and called-only accuracy, because mixing an abstaining rule into a family of always-call comparators changes what the correction means. Exclusion from the family is not exclusion from the manuscript.
